up: Retrieve the distinct compound ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for molecules tested against the human serine/threonine-protein kinase PLK1 (target ChEMBL ID: CHEMBL3024). Join activities with assays and target_dictionary, filtering by target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3024'. Use molecule_dictionary to get the compound ChEMBL ID and compound_structures to get the canonical SMILES. Return distinct rows.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assays a ON td.tid = a.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3024'
